paragraphs: Gameweek 5 turned a tight table upside down. Shao had the week of the league with 64 points, powered by 17 from Semenyo and a bench that wasted nothing, to jump from 6th to 3rd, while Croft's 58 lifted him from 5th to 2nd. Mariswamy went the other way: second going into the week, he managed just 31, his lowest of the season, and dropped to last despite making two transfers.

Wedd stays top, but only just. His 51 was nothing special, though captaining Isak (16 points) while the other five all backed Haaland (12 once doubled) gave him a useful four-point edge. Croft sits seven points behind, and the whole table is separated by just 24. Klotz left 15 points on his bench in a 42-point week, and João Pedro not featuring forced auto-subs for four managers.
